translations.web: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
translations.bsb: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow will pierce him.
translations.kjv: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
translations.asv: He shall flee from the iron weapon, And the bow of brass shall strike him through.
